Ciutat Meridiana — Barcelona, Spain

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

The most substantial documented crime coverage in this district. In April 2024, Mossos/Guardia Civil dismantled 'Los Demons de Ciutat Meridiana', a youth gang engaged in drug trafficking, violent robberies, fraud and bladed-weapon assaults; 11 arrested with firearms, machetes, axes and katanas seized. Separately, Metròpoli Obert (2021) documented an established 'squatting-for-payment' racket run by organized groups, and multiple outlets describe the barri as Barcelona's poorest, citing a historic housing-eviction crisis and social isolation. Several outlets are also explicit that no official barri-level crime statistics exist and that some 'no-go' framing is exaggerated. Sources checked: metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, 10 May 2024 / Mar 2021 / 2020; eldebate.com, Apr 2025.
